title: Materi 3.2.1: Pengenalan Reference
content:
Materi 3.2.1: Pengenalan ReferenceReference atau kata ganti adalah salah satu topik yang PASTI muncul di SNBT. Pahami konsep dasar sampai strategi jitu buat jawab soalnya dengan benar!Apa Itu Reference dan Kenapa Penting?

Bayangin kamu lagi baca novel atau artikel, terus setiap kali nyebut nama tokoh atau benda, harus ngulang-ngulang nama lengkapnya. Annoying banget kan? Nah, makanya ada yang namanya reference atau kata ganti!

Reference itu kayak "pengganti" buat kata benda (noun) yang udah disebutin sebelumnya. Jadi kita nggak perlu ngulang-ngulang kata yang sama. Contohnya:

"Sarah is a brilliant student. She always gets straight A's."

Nah, kata "she" di sini itu reference yang ngganti "Sarah". Simple, kan?

Kenapa Soal Reference Sering Muncul di SNBT?

Di SNBT, soal reference ini PASTI muncul! Biasanya bentuknya kayak gini:

  • "The word 'they' in line 15 refers to..."
  • "What does 'it' in paragraph 2 refer to?"
  • "The pronoun 'this' in the last sentence refers to..."

Soal ini sebenarnya ngetes ketelitian kamu. Banyak yang kecele karena:

ASAL NJAWAB tanpa baca kalimat sebelumnyaKETIPU sama kata benda yang paling deket (padahal belum tentu itu jawabannya!)NGGAK NGECEK singular/plural atau genderJenis-Jenis Pronouns (Kata Ganti)

Ada beberapa jenis pronoun yang bakal kamu temuin:

  • Subject: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
  • Object: me, you, him, her, it, us, them
  • Possessive: my, your, his, her, its, our, their (+ mine, yours, hers, ours, theirs)
  • Singular: This, that
  • Plural: These, those
  • Who, whom, whose, which, that
  • One, ones, some, others, another
The Golden Rule: SELALU BACA KALIMAT SEBELUMNYA!Ini kunci utama buat nge-solve soal reference: 90% jawaban ada di kalimat SEBELUM pronoun itu muncul!

Kadang juga bisa di kalimat yang sama, tapi sebelum pronoun-nya. Jarang banget jawabannya di kalimat SESUDAHNYA (kecuali dalam kasus tertentu).

Antecedent: Si "Tokoh Asli" yang DigantikanAntecedent itu istilah fancy buat "kata benda yang digantikan oleh pronoun".

Contoh:

"The researchers conducted multiple experiments. They discovered something groundbreaking."

Yang mana antecedent-nya? YUP, "The researchers"! Karena kata "they" nggantiin "the researchers".

Quick Tips Buat Identifikasi ReferenceStrategiPenjelasanContoh✅ Cek NumberSingular/Plural harus cocokIt, this, that, he, she → cari noun SINGULAR
They, these, those → cari noun PLURAL✅ Cek GenderKalau pakai he/sheHe → laki-laki
She → perempuan✅ Proximity PrincipleBiasanya (tapi nggak selalu!)Pronoun merujuk ke noun yang terdekat✅ Logic CheckApakah masuk akal?Coba substitute pronoun dengan noun pilihan kamu, make sense nggak?
Jebakan Umum yang Harus Diwaspadai!JEBAKAN #1: Multiple Nouns Sebelumnya

Kadang di satu kalimat ada beberapa noun, terus kamu bingung mana yang dimaksud. Contoh:

"The company announced that their employees would receive bonuses. They were thrilled."

"They" itu siapa? Company atau employees?

→ Employees! Karena company itu singular (seharusnya "it"), dan yang "thrilled" itu logically para karyawan, bukan perusahaannya.

JEBAKAN #2: Pronoun Merujuk ke WHOLE IDEA

Sometimes, pronoun nggak merujuk ke satu noun spesifik, tapi ke SELURUH kalimat atau ide sebelumnya!

"The government increased taxes, reduced public services, and cut education funding. This caused widespread protests."

"This" merujuk ke apa? → Bukan cuma "education funding", tapi ke SELURUH KEBIJAKAN pemerintah!

JEBAKAN #3: Distractor dengan Kata yang Sama

Kadang opsi jawaban pakai kata yang sama dari teks, padahal bukan itu maksudnya!

"Scientists believe that climate change is accelerating. This belief is supported by data."

Kalau ditanya "this belief" refers to apa, jawabannya BUKAN "Scientists" atau "climate change" secara terpisah, tapi "Scientists' belief that climate change is accelerating" → complete idea!

Variasi Pertanyaan dalam Soal SNBTDIRECT REFERENCE: "The word 'they' refers to..."INDIRECT REFERENCE: "What does the author mean by 'it' in line...?"COMPLEX REFERENCE: "The phrase 'such activities' in paragraph 3 refers to..."Link ke Topik LainReference ini sebenarnya bagian dari coherence devices (Topik 2.3). Pronoun itu salah satu cara penulis bikin teks jadi kohesif dan nggak ngebosenin karena ngulang-ngulang kata yang sama.

Plus, understanding reference juga ngebantu banget buat:

  • Paraphrase (Topik 3.3): Karena kamu ngerti siapa/apa yang dimaksud
  • Main Idea (Topik 1.1): Pronoun ngebantu kamu track subject utama dalam paragraf
  • Text Coherence (Topik 2.3): Pronoun = salah satu connector antar kalimat
Sekarang kamu udah paham konsep dasar reference! Di materi selanjutnya, kita bakal bahas teknik-teknik spesifik buat ngerjain soal reference dengan cepat dan akurat. Stay tuned!

title: Materi 3.2.2: Analisis Personal Pronouns Reference
content:
Materi 3.2.2: Analisis Personal Pronouns ReferencePersonal pronouns adalah kata ganti yang paling sering keluar di soal SNBT! Di materi ini kita bakal bedah tuntas gimana cara mengidentifikasi reference dari berbagai jenis personal pronouns dengan tepat dan cepat.Apa Itu Personal Pronouns?

Personal pronouns itu kata ganti yang paling umum dan paling sering muncul di soal SNBT. Fungsinya simpel: menggantikan orang atau benda tertentu dalam kalimat biar nggak ngulang-ulang kata yang sama terus.

Tabel Lengkap Personal PronounsFungsiSingular (Tunggal)Plural (Jamak)Subject (pelaku)I, you, he, she, itwe, you, theyObject (penerima)me, you, him, her, itus, you, themPossessive Adjective (kepemilikan + kata benda)my, your, his, her, itsour, your, theirPossessive Pronoun (kepemilikan berdiri sendiri)mine, yours, his, hers, -ours, yours, theirs
Subject Pronouns: Si Pelaku Aksi

Subject pronouns itu yang melakukan aksi dalam kalimat. Posisinya selalu di awal kalimat atau clause, tepat sebelum verb (kata kerja).

Ciri-ciri Subject Pronouns: Selalu diikuti oleh VERB dan menjadi subject dari kalimat/clause tersebut.

Contoh dalam konteks bacaan:

"Dr. Martinez specializes in neuroscience. She has published over 50 research papers on brain plasticity."

Di sini, "She" = subject pronoun yang merujuk ke Dr. Martinez.

Tips Identifikasi Subject PronounsCek verb setelahnya → apakah singular atau plural?He/She/It selalu diikuti singular verb (is, has, does, kata kerja + s)They/We selalu diikuti plural verb (are, have, do, kata kerja tanpa s)JEBAKAN UMUM: "The team of researchers presented their findings. They had worked for three years on the project." — Hati-hati! "They" bukan merujuk ke "researchers" meskipun lebih dekat! Tapi merujuk ke "team" (sebagai kelompok kolektif). Tergantung konteks — kalau dianggap satu kesatuan = "it", kalau dianggap individu-individu = "they".

Di soal SNBT, biasanya:

  • American English: "The team is..." (singular)
  • British English: "The team are..." (plural)

Tapi untuk soal reference, yang penting: cek logic dan verb agreement-nya!

Object Pronouns: Si Penerima Aksi

Object pronouns itu yang menerima aksi dalam kalimat. Posisinya setelah verb atau setelah preposisi (in, on, at, with, for, to, dan lain-lain).

Ciri-ciri Object Pronouns: Muncul setelah VERB (direct object) atau setelah PREPOSITION (object of preposition).

Contoh 1 (setelah verb):

"The professor gave the students a challenging assignment. He warned them about the deadline."

"Them" = object pronoun yang merujuk ke "students".

Contoh 2 (setelah preposisi):

"Climate activists have been protesting for months. The government finally agreed to meet with them."

"Them" (setelah preposisi "with") = merujuk ke "climate activists".

Tips Identifikasi Object PronounsKalau pronoun muncul setelah verb action atau preposisi → kemungkinan besar OBJECT pronounCek: siapa yang menerima aksi? Itu antecedent-nya!JEBAKAN UMUM: "The CEO asked the board members to reconsider. She wanted them to delay the decision." — "Them" merujuk ke siapa? Jawabannya: Board members, bukan CEO! Kenapa? Karena yang diminta untuk delay decision itu board members, bukan CEO-nya sendiri.Possessive Adjectives: Penunjuk Kepemilikan + Kata Benda

Possessive adjectives itu menunjukkan kepemilikan dan SELALU diikuti oleh kata benda (noun).

Formula: Possessive Adjective + NOUN

Contoh:

"Indonesia is known for its cultural diversity. Its traditions have been preserved for centuries."

"Its" = possessive adjective yang merujuk ke "Indonesia". Perhatikan: "its" diikuti oleh noun "traditions"!

Contoh lengkap:

"The scientist dedicated her entire career to cancer research. Her discoveries have saved countless lives."

"Her" (possessive adjective) + "discoveries" (noun) = merujuk ke "the scientist".

Catatan Super Penting tentang ITS vs IT'SITS = possessive (kepemilikan) → "its benefits", "its impact" | IT'S = it is (singkatan) → BUKAN possessive!

Kesalahan umum:

  • ❌ "The company increased it's profits" → SALAH!
  • ✅ "The company increased its profits" → BENAR!
Di SNBT, jebakan "its" sering banget muncul! Kalau ada soal reference tentang "its", antecedent-nya pasti singular noun (biasanya benda, organisasi, hewan, atau konsep).Possessive Pronouns: Kepemilikan Berdiri Sendiri

Possessive pronouns itu mirip possessive adjectives, tapi NGGAK diikuti noun karena dia standalone (berdiri sendiri).

Formula: Possessive Pronoun (tanpa noun setelahnya!)

Contoh:

"This research is groundbreaking, but ours is more comprehensive."

"Ours" = possessive pronoun (standalone, nggak diikuti noun) yang merujuk ke "our research".

Perbedaan Possessive Adjective vs Possessive PronounPossessive Adjective + NounPossessive Pronoun (standalone)This is my bookThis book is mineYour idea is greatThe great idea is yoursTheir study is importantThe important study is theirs

Di soal SNBT, possessive pronouns agak jarang muncul, tapi tetep harus kamu pahami!

Aturan Agreement: Kunci Jawaban yang BenarRULE #1: Number Agreement (Singular vs Plural)

Pronoun harus sesuai dengan jumlah (number) antecedent-nya!

Singular antecedent → singular pronoun (The student → he/she/his/her | The book → it/its)Plural antecedent → plural pronoun (The researchers → they/them/their)JEBAKAN dengan Collective Nouns: Collective nouns (group, team, committee, family, government, company, class) bisa singular ATAU plural tergantung konteks!

Contoh:

  • "The committee made its decision." → dianggap satu unit
  • "The committee were divided in their opinions." → dianggap individu-individu
Di SNBT: Kalau ada soal reference tentang collective noun, cek verb-nya! Singular verb = singular pronoun, plural verb = plural pronoun.RULE #2: Gender Agreement (He vs She)

Ini cuma berlaku kalau antecedent-nya ORANG dengan gender yang jelas.

Male person → he/him/hisFemale person → she/her/hersGender-neutral/unknown → they/them/their (modern usage)

Contoh:

"Dr. Emily Chen has extensive experience in virology. She led the research team during the pandemic."

Gender-nya jelas → female → "she"!

Catatan Modern: Sekarang, singular "they" udah diterima untuk merujuk ke seseorang dengan unknown gender atau gender-neutral. Contoh: "If a student wants to succeed, they should study regularly." (Dulu: "he or she", sekarang lebih umum: "they")RULE #3: Person Agreement (First/Second/Third Person)

Jangan campur-campur person!

  • ❌ "If one wants to succeed, you should work hard." → INCONSISTENT!
  • ✅ "If one wants to succeed, one should work hard." → CONSISTENT!
  • ✅ "If you want to succeed, you should work hard." → CONSISTENT!
Kasus Spesial: IT

"It" itu pronoun yang paling fleksibel dan kadang tricky!

Penggunaan IT"The theory is controversial, but it is supported by evidence.""The university announced that it would increase scholarships.""Global warming is accelerating, and it poses serious threats.""It is raining." → "it" nggak merujuk ke apa-apa, cuma grammatical. "It is 5 PM."IT yang Merujuk ke Seluruh Kalimat

Contoh penting:

"The government raised taxes significantly. It angered many citizens."

Wait, "it" merujuk ke apa? Bukan "taxes" atau "government", tapi "the fact that government raised taxes" → whole action/idea!

JEBAKAN UMUM dengan IT: Di soal SNBT, kalau ditanya "it" refers to apa, jangan langsung pilih noun terdekat! Cek dulu context dan logic: Apakah "it" merujuk ke satu noun spesifik? Atau merujuk ke whole idea/situation?Contoh Bacaan untuk Latihan

"Scientists discovered a new species of frog in the Amazon rainforest. The species exhibits unique color patterns that help it camouflage in the environment. This discovery is significant because it suggests biodiversity in the region is higher than previously thought."

Pertanyaan 1: "What does 'it' in the second sentence refer to?"

❌ Scientists (plural, harusnya "them")❌ Amazon rainforest (nggak make sense secara logic)❌ Color patterns (plural, harusnya "they")✅ The species (singular, secara logic yang camouflage itu species-nya!)

Pertanyaan 2: "What does 'it' in the third sentence refer to?"

❌ The region (logically wrong)✅ The discovery (BENAR! Discovery itu singular noun dan secara logic, discovery itu yang "suggests")Pendekatan Praktis untuk Personal PronounsIkuti 7 langkah ini setiap kali menghadapi soal reference tentang personal pronouns!STEP 1: Identify the pronoun dan cek jenis-nya (subject/object/possessive)STEP 2: Cek number (singular or plural?)STEP 3: Cek gender (kalau applicable: he/she)STEP 4: Scan kalimat SEBELUMNYA untuk possible antecedentsSTEP 5: Eliminate yang number/gender-nya nggak matchSTEP 6: Dari sisa options, pilih yang paling make sense secara LOGICSTEP 7: VERIFY dengan substitute pronoun dengan noun pilihan kamu → make sense nggak?Mini Contoh Bacaan (Analysis)

"Artificial intelligence is transforming industries worldwide. Its applications range from healthcare to transportation. Many experts believe that it will continue to evolve rapidly in the coming decades. However, they also warn about potential ethical concerns. Their recommendations emphasize the need for regulation."

Analysis:

PronounRefers toAlasan"Its"Artificial intelligenceSingular possessive"it" (pertama)Artificial intelligenceSingular subject"they"expertsPlural subject"Their"expertsPlural possessive
See the pattern? Selalu match number, selalu cek logic, dan selalu verify! Dengan latihan terus-menerus, kamu bakal bisa identify reference dengan cepat dan akurat.

title: Materi 3.2.3: Analisis Demonstrative Pronouns Reference
content:
Materi 3.2.3: Analisis Demonstrative Pronouns ReferenceDemonstrative pronouns (this, that, these, those) adalah kata ganti yang menunjuk ke sesuatu atau ide tertentu dalam teks. Mereka lebih tricky dibanding personal pronouns karena bisa merujuk ke satu noun spesifik ATAU keseluruhan ide/klausa!Apa Itu Demonstrative Pronouns?

Demonstrative pronouns itu kata ganti yang menunjuk ke sesuatu (demonstrate = menunjukkan). Mereka kayak "pointing words" yang nge-refer ke noun atau idea tertentu dalam bacaan.

Empat Demonstrative Pronouns UtamaKata GantiJumlahJarakContoh PenggunaanThisSingularDekat/baru disebutkanThis is importantThatSingularJauh/disebutkan lebih duluThat was mentioned earlierThesePluralDekat/baru disebutkanThese are crucialThosePluralJauh/disebutkan lebih duluThose were discussed before
Kenapa Demonstrative Pronouns Tricky di SNBT?

Demonstrative pronouns itu lebih susah dibanding personal pronouns karena beberapa alasan:

Bisa merujuk ke SATU NOUN spesifik ATAU SELURUH IDEA/KLAUSA (yang sering bikin bingung!)Bisa merujuk ke sesuatu yang belum disebutkan (forward reference)Proximity (dekat/jauh) bisa temporal (waktu) ATAU spatial (ruang)Di teks akademik, perbedaan "this" vs "that" sering blur dan nggak strict

Makanya, soal tentang demonstrative pronouns ini sering jadi jebakan di SNBT!

THIS dan THAT: Kata Penunjuk SingularTHIS = dekat, baru saja disebutkan, recent. THAT = jauh, disebutkan lebih awal, distant. Tapi di teks akademik, yang lebih penting adalah: APA yang dirujuk, bukan seberapa jauh/dekatnya!Case 1: Merujuk ke Noun Spesifik (Singular)

Contoh bacaan:

"The research methodology was rigorous and well-designed. This ensured the validity of the findings."

Analisis:

"This" di sini merujuk ke → "research methodology" (singular noun)

Kenapa bukan "findings"? Karena:

  • "Findings" itu plural (seharusnya pakai "these")
  • Secara logika, yang memastikan validity itu methodology-nya, bukan findings-nya sendiri
TRIK VERIFIKASI: Ganti "this" dengan noun pilihan kamu. Contoh: "The research methodology ensured the validity of the findings." → Make sense? Kalau iya, berarti bener!Case 2: Merujuk ke KESELURUHAN IDEA/KLAUSA

Ini yang paling tricky dan paling sering keluar di SNBT!

Contoh bacaan:

"The government implemented strict environmental regulations, increased penalties for violations, and established monitoring systems. This led to significant improvements in air quality."

Pertanyaan: "This" refers to what?

Opsi Jebakan:

  • Monitoring systems (❌ terlalu spesifik, hanya satu bagian)
  • Penalties (❌ terlalu spesifik)
  • Environmental regulations (❌ terlalu sempit)

Jawaban Benar:

  • The government's comprehensive environmental policies (✅ keseluruhan tindakan!)

"This" di sini merujuk ke SELURUH rangkaian aksi pemerintah, bukan cuma satu komponen!

Cara Mengenali Whole-Idea ReferenceCLUE #1: "This" diikuti langsung oleh VERB (kata kerja) → kemungkinan besar merujuk whole idea. Contoh: "This caused..." vs "This method was used..." (yang kedua merujuk specific noun "method")CLUE #2: Kalimat sebelumnya kompleks dengan banyak informasi → kemungkinan "this" refers to the whole thingCLUE #3: Logic check → Tanya diri sendiri: "Apa yang MENYEBABKAN hasil ini?" Biasanya bukan satu noun, tapi kombinasi actions/factorsCase 3: Demonstrative + NOUN (Demonstrative Adjective)

Wait, ini bukan pronoun lagi! Ini demonstrative ADJECTIVE karena diikuti noun.

Contoh:

"Several theories explain the phenomenon. However, this theory is the most widely accepted."

"This theory" → "this" itu adjective yang memodifikasi "theory", jadi bukan pronoun reference question!

Kalau demonstrative diikuti noun, yang dirujuk itu NOUN dengan karakteristik tertentu yang disebutkan sebelumnya! Ini beda dengan demonstrative pronoun yang stand alone.THESE dan THOSE: Kata Penunjuk PluralTHESE = plural, dekat (recently mentioned). THOSE = plural, jauh (mentioned earlier). Sama seperti singular, yang penting adalah APA yang dirujuk!Case 1: Merujuk ke Plural Nouns Spesifik

Contoh bacaan:

"Advanced technologies such as AI, blockchain, and quantum computing are revolutionizing industries. These are transforming how businesses operate."

"These" merujuk ke → "Advanced technologies" (atau bisa juga "AI, blockchain, and quantum computing")

Verifikasi: "AI, blockchain, and quantum computing are transforming..." → Makes sense!

Case 2: Merujuk ke Multiple Ideas/Points

Contoh bacaan:

"The study identified three major challenges: insufficient funding, lack of qualified personnel, and outdated equipment. These must be addressed urgently."

"These" merujuk ke → "three major challenges" atau specifically "insufficient funding, lack of qualified personnel, and outdated equipment"

Mana yang lebih baik?

Tergantung opsi yang tersedia! Kalau ada opsi "three major challenges" → itu lebih general dan safe. Kalau opsinya list semua → itu juga bisa correct.

Di SNBT, pilih yang: (1) Paling COMPLETE (mencakup semua elemen), (2) Paling CONCISE (ringkas tapi tetap accurate)Case 3: Kontras THESE vs THOSE

Kadang dalam satu teks ada "these" DAN "those" untuk membedakan dua groups!

Contoh bacaan:

"There are two types of research methods: qualitative and quantitative. Those (quantitative methods) rely on numerical data, while these (qualitative methods) focus on descriptive information."

Analisis:

  • "Those" → quantitative methods (disebutkan pertama, jadi "lebih jauh")
  • "These" → qualitative methods (disebutkan kedua, jadi "lebih dekat")
Hati-hati! Kontras ini nggak selalu strict. Kadang "these" dan "those" dipakai interchangeably kalau konteksnya sudah jelas.Fitur Spesial: "SUCH" sebagai Demonstrative

"Such" itu technically bukan demonstrative pronoun, tapi functionally mirip!

Contoh:

"The experiment involved complex procedures and required specialized equipment. Such endeavors demand significant resources."

"Such endeavors" merujuk ke → "experiments that involve complex procedures and require specialized equipment"

"Such" merujuk ke TYPE atau CATEGORY yang disebutkan sebelumnya, bukan noun spesifiknya!The Infamous "THIS" di Awal Kalimat

Di teks akademik, penulis sering banget mulai kalimat dengan "This..." tanpa ngasih clear antecedent. Ini bisa bikin bingung!

Strategi MenghadapinyaSTEP 1: Baca SELURUH kalimat sebelumnya dengan telitiSTEP 2: Identify: Apa MAIN POINT atau ACTION di kalimat itu?STEP 3: "This" kemungkinan besar refers to that main point

Contoh:

"Researchers discovered that sleep deprivation significantly impairs cognitive function, reduces memory consolidation, and weakens immune response. This highlights the importance of adequate sleep."

Pertanyaan: "This" refers to?

Think: Apa yang "highlights the importance"? → FAKTA bahwa sleep deprivation punya semua efek negatif itu!

Jawaban: "The finding that sleep deprivation impairs cognitive function, reduces memory consolidation, and weakens immune response" (atau simplified: "The research findings" / "The discovery about sleep deprivation's effects")

Jebakan Umum dengan DemonstrativesTrap #1: Asumsi Nearest NounJangan langsung assume "this/that" merujuk ke noun yang paling deket!

Contoh:

"The policy failed to address income inequality despite the government's promises. This disappointed many citizens."

"This" refers to apa?

  • Promises? (nearest noun) ❌
  • Policy? ❌
  • The fact that the policy failed ✅ (whole idea!)
Trap #2: Number MismatchJangan pilih plural noun untuk "this/that" atau singular noun untuk "these/those"!

Contoh:

"Various studies have confirmed the link. This is now widely accepted."

Wait, "this" itu singular tapi "studies" plural! "This" refers to apa?

→ "The link" (singular) atau "The fact that studies confirmed the link" (whole idea, treated as singular)

Trap #3: Opsi dengan Kata dari Teks

Kadang opsi jawaban pakai exact words dari teks, tapi wrong reference!

Contoh:

"Scientists developed a new vaccine using mRNA technology. This could revolutionize medicine."

Opsi:

  1. Scientists
  2. Vaccine
  3. mRNA technology
  4. The development of the vaccine using mRNA technology

"This could revolutionize" → apa yang bisa revolutionize?

→ Bukan "scientists" atau "technology" alone, tapi "the vaccine" (B) atau "the development" (D)

Di sini, B (vaccine) dan D (development) sama-sama reasonable, tapi D lebih complete dan comprehensive!Demonstratives dan Proximity (Dekat vs Jauh)Temporal Proximity (Waktu)DemonstrativeTemporal MeaningContohThis/TheseJust mentioned, recent, currentRecent studies show...That/ThoseMentioned earlier, past, previousEarlier research indicated...

Contoh:

"Last year, researchers proposed a new theory. More recently, they conducted experiments to test it. That theory has now been validated."

"That theory" → merujuk ke theory yang disebutkan di kalimat pertama (farther back in time)

Di modern English, terutama dalam academic writing, perbedaan "this" vs "that" untuk proximity udah nggak strict! Yang lebih penting: CLARITY dan LOGIC.Advanced Pattern: Demonstrative + Summary Noun

Ini pattern yang sophisticated dan sering di teks SNBT level tinggi!

Contoh:

"The economy is growing, unemployment is falling, and consumer confidence is rising. These positive indicators suggest a strong recovery."

"These positive indicators" merujuk ke → "economic growth, falling unemployment, and rising consumer confidence"

PATTERN: These/Those + SUMMARY NOUN (indicators, factors, challenges, benefits, etc.) → Summary noun itu kayak "label" buat group of things yang disebutkan sebelumnya!Cara Mengerjakan Soal Demonstrative ReferenceIkuti langkah-langkah sistematis ini untuk menjawab soal demonstrative pronoun reference dengan akurat!STEP 1: Identify demonstrative-nya (this, that, these, those)STEP 2: Check number → This/That = singular ATAU whole idea (treated as singular). These/Those = plural ATAU multiple ideasSTEP 3: Baca kalimat SEBELUMNYA dengan hati-hati dan telitiSTEP 4: Tanya: Specific noun atau whole idea? → Specific noun = cari matching singular/plural noun. Whole idea = summarize main pointSTEP 5: Eliminate wrong options → Number mismatch (❌), Logically wrong (❌)STEP 6: VERIFY by substitution → Ganti demonstrative dengan pilihan kamu → make sense?STEP 7: When in doubt, lean towards WHOLE IDEA interpretation (karena ini paling sering!)Mini Practice: Analisis Bacaan

Contoh bacaan:

"Climate change is causing unprecedented environmental shifts. Glaciers are melting at alarming rates, sea levels are rising, and extreme weather events are becoming more frequent. These changes threaten coastal communities and ecosystems worldwide. Scientists warn that without immediate action, this could lead to irreversible damage. That is why international cooperation is crucial."

Analisis LengkapMerujuk ke: "glaciers melting, sea levels rising, and extreme weather events becoming more frequent" (multiple effects, plural)Merujuk ke: "the situation/condition of climate change and its effects" (whole idea, treated as singular)Merujuk ke: "the potential for irreversible damage" atau "the urgency of the climate crisis" (mentioned in previous sentence)Lihat bagaimana demonstratives menciptakan COHESION (keterkaitan) di seluruh teks? Mereka menghubungkan ide-ide antar kalimat dan membuat bacaan mengalir!Ringkasan Poin PentingDemonstrative pronouns (this, that, these, those) menunjuk ke noun atau idea tertentuYang paling tricky: demonstrative bisa merujuk ke WHOLE IDEA/CLAUSE, bukan cuma specific nounClue whole-idea reference: demonstrative diikuti verb, kalimat sebelumnya kompleks, logic checkJangan jebakan: nearest noun assumption, number mismatch, kata dari teks belum tentu benarThis/That = singular atau whole idea. These/Those = plural atau multiple ideasVerifikasi dengan substitution: ganti demonstrative dengan pilihan kamuWhen in doubt: lean towards WHOLE IDEA interpretation!

title: Materi 3.2.4: Analisis Relative Pronouns dan Other References
content:
Materi 3.2.4: Analisis Relative Pronouns dan Other ReferencesRelative pronouns itu kata penghubung yang introduce relative clauses (klausa yang ngasih informasi tambahan tentang noun). Mari kita pelajari gimana cara mengidentifikasi dan memahami berbagai jenis reference dalam teks bahasa Inggris!Apa Itu Relative Pronouns?

Relative pronouns adalah kata-kata penghubung yang digunakan untuk memperkenalkan klausa relatif - yaitu bagian kalimat yang memberikan informasi tambahan tentang noun (kata benda) yang disebutkan sebelumnya.

Gang Relative Pronouns yang harus kamu kenal: • WHO → untuk ORANG (sebagai subject) • WHOM → untuk ORANG (sebagai object) • WHOSE → untuk menunjukkan KEPEMILIKAN • WHICH → untuk BENDA atau HEWAN • THAT → untuk ORANG atau BENDA (paling versatile!)WHO: The People Person

"Who" digunakan untuk merujuk ke ORANG dan berfungsi sebagai SUBJECT dari relative clause.

Formula dasar penggunaan WHO: Noun (person) + WHO + VERB

Contoh dalam bacaan:

"Dr. Sarah Johnson, who has dedicated 20 years to cancer research, recently received a Nobel Prize."

Di sini, "who" merujuk kepada → Dr. Sarah Johnson

Poin Kunci: "Who" selalu diikuti oleh VERB karena dia berfungsi sebagai subject!

Pola umum yang sering muncul:

"Scientists who study climate patterns have observed significant changes."

"Who" di sini menghubungkan "scientists" dengan "study climate patterns"

WHOM: The Formal Object

"Whom" juga digunakan untuk ORANG, tapi bedanya dia berfungsi sebagai OBJECT dari verb atau preposisi.

Formula penggunaan WHOM: Noun (person) + WHOM + SUBJECT + VERB

Contoh:

"The researcher whom the university hired last year is already making breakthroughs."

"Whom" merujuk ke → "researcher" (researcher adalah OBJECT dari kata kerja "hired")

Fun Fact: Dalam percakapan bahasa Inggris modern, "whom" udah jarang banget dipakai dan sering diganti sama "who": • Formal: "the person whom I met" • Casual: "the person who I met" atau "the person I met" (relative pronoun dihilangkan!)Tapi ingat! Di SNBT, teks akademik masih menggunakan "whom" secara proper, jadi kamu harus bisa mengenalinya!

Pola dengan Preposisi:

"The scientist to whom the award was given is very humble."

"Whom" merujuk ke → "scientist" (scientist adalah object dari preposisi "to")

Alternatif yang lebih casual:

"The scientist who the award was given to..."

WHOSE: The Possessive Connector

"Whose" digunakan untuk menunjukkan KEPEMILIKAN dan bisa dipakai untuk orang ATAU benda!

Formula WHOSE: Noun + WHOSE + NOUN + VERB

Contoh untuk ORANG:

"The author whose book won the Pulitzer Prize will speak at the conference."

"Whose" merujuk ke → "the author" (dan "book" adalah milik author tersebut)

Contoh untuk BENDA:

"The company whose headquarters is in Silicon Valley is a tech giant."

"Whose" merujuk ke → "the company" (headquarters adalah milik company tersebut)

Ciri Khas: "Whose" SELALU diikuti oleh NOUN (benda yang dimiliki)!WHICH: For Things and Animals

"Which" digunakan untuk merujuk ke BENDA, HEWAN, atau IDEAS (bukan orang!).

Formula WHICH: Noun (thing/animal) + WHICH + VERB/SUBJECT + VERB

Contoh Defining Clause:

"The theory which Einstein proposed revolutionized physics."

"Which" merujuk ke → "theory"

Contoh Non-Defining Clause:

"The research, which took five years to complete, has significant implications."

"Which" merujuk ke → "the research"

Bedanya: • Defining clause (tanpa koma): memberikan info penting yang restrictive • Non-defining clause (dengan koma): memberikan info tambahan yang non-essentialPenggunaan Spesial: "Which" Merujuk ke Seluruh Klausa

Ini super penting! "Which" bisa merujuk ke SELURUH klausa sebelumnya, bukan cuma satu noun aja!

Contoh:

"The experiment failed repeatedly, which surprised the researchers."

"Which" merujuk ke apa?

→ "Fakta bahwa eksperimen gagal berulang kali" (SELURUH IDE, bukan cuma "experiment" atau "researchers")

Cara tahu: Kalau ada KOMA + which, dan secara logika "which" nggak masuk akal kalau cuma merujuk ke noun terdekat → kemungkinan besar merujuk ke whole clause!THAT: The Universal Connector

"That" adalah yang paling versatile! Bisa dipakai untuk ORANG atau BENDA.

Contoh untuk ORANG:

"The scientist that discovered the cure is now famous."

Contoh untuk BENDA:

"The method that researchers used is innovative."

Aturan Penting tentang THAT: ✅ "That" dipakai untuk defining (restrictive) clauses → TANPA koma ❌ "That" TIDAK dipakai untuk non-defining clauses (pakai "which" instead)BENAR: "The book that I read was fascinating." (defining, tanpa koma)BENAR: "The book, which I read last month, was fascinating." (non-defining, pakai koma)SALAH: "The book, that I read last month, was fascinating." ❌Tips SNBT: Kalau ada clause dengan koma → pakai "which" (untuk benda) atau "who" (untuk orang) Kalau TANPA koma → bisa pakai "that", "which", atau "who"ONE dan ONES: The Generic References

"One" dan "ones" adalah kata ganti untuk NOUN yang sudah disebutkan sebelumnya, biar nggak repetitif.

ONE (Singular):

"I need a pen. Do you have one?"

"One" = a pen (secara umum, bukan pen yang spesifik)

Dalam Teks Akademik:

"Traditional methods are effective, but modern ones are faster."

"Ones" merujuk ke → "methods" (metode-metode modern)

Pola umum: Adjective + ONE/ONES Contoh: "The red car is expensive, but the blue one is affordable." "One" = car (mobil warna biru)SOME, OTHERS, ANOTHER: The Subset References

Ini adalah pronouns yang merujuk ke SUBSET atau bagian dari grup yang sudah disebutkan.

SOME:

"The participants were divided into groups. Some received the treatment, while others served as controls."

"Some" merujuk ke → "beberapa dari partisipan"

OTHERS:

"Others" merujuk ke → "partisipan lainnya" (yang nggak dapat treatment)

ANOTHER:

"One theory suggests genetic factors. Another focuses on environmental causes."

"Another" merujuk ke → "teori lain" (berbeda dari teori pertama)

Pola yang sering muncul: • Some... others... → membagi grup menjadi beberapa bagian • One... another... yet another... → menyebutkan item/ide yang berbeda-bedaSUCH: The Type Indicator

"Such" merujuk ke TIPE atau JENIS yang disebutkan sebelumnya.

Contoh:

"The study used randomized controlled trials, double-blind procedures, and peer review. Such rigorous methods ensure reliability."

"Such rigorous methods" merujuk ke → "randomized controlled trials, double-blind procedures, and peer review" (JENIS-JENIS metode tersebut)

Pola: SUCH + NOUN → merujuk ke contoh-contoh dari tipe yang disebutkan sebelumnyaFORMER dan LATTER: The First and Last

"Former" dan "latter" digunakan untuk merujuk ke dua hal yang disebutkan, terutama dalam tulisan akademik/formal.

FORMER = yang pertama disebutkanLATTER = yang terakhir disebutkan

Contoh:

"Both wind energy and solar power are renewable. The former is more suitable for coastal areas, while the latter works better in sunny regions."

KataMerujuk KePenjelasanFormerwind energyDisebutkan pertamaLattersolar powerDisebutkan terakhir
Penting! Former dan latter hanya dipakai untuk DUA item! Kalau lebih dari dua, gunakan "the first", "the second", "the last" instead.Reference Chains: Following the Thread

Kadang dalam satu paragraf, ada rangkaian reference yang saling terhubung!

Contoh Bacaan:

"Marie Curie was a pioneering scientist. She conducted groundbreaking research on radioactivity. Her discoveries earned her two Nobel Prizes. This achievement made her the first woman to win the award, and the only person to win in two different sciences."

Analisis Reference Chain:"She" → Marie Curie"Her" (pertama) → possessive, kepunyaan Marie Curie"Her" (kedua) → object pronoun, Marie Curie"This achievement" → memenangkan dua Nobel Prize"Her" (ketiga) → Marie Curie"The award" → Nobel Prize

Lihat bagaimana pronouns menciptakan narasi yang terhubung? Memahami reference chains membantu kamu mengikuti teks yang kompleks!

Ambiguous References: When It's Unclear

Kadang-kadang, reference bisa ambigu (bisa beberapa kemungkinan). Gimana cara memecahkannya?

Contoh:

"John told Mark that he should prepare the presentation."

"He" merujuk ke siapa? John atau Mark?

→ Ambigu dari kalimat ini aja!

Strategi Resolusi Ambiguitas:

1. Lihat kalimat BERIKUTNYA untuk klarifikasi:

"John told Mark that he should prepare the presentation. Mark agreed and started working immediately."

→ Ah, "he" = Mark!

2. Gunakan logika/konteks:

"John told Mark that he should prepare the presentation. After all, it was Mark's area of expertise."

→ Logika: "he" = Mark (karena expertise-nya Mark)

3. Cari petunjuk dari verb agreement:

"The committee told the researchers that they should revise."

→ "They" = researchers (plural, sedangkan committee biasanya singular "it")

Di SNBT: Kalau reference ambigu, teks biasanya memberikan petunjuk konteks tambahan. Baca dengan teliti!Jebakan Umum dengan Relative PronounsJEBAKAN #1: Bingung "Which" vs "That"

Ingat:

  • "Which" bisa untuk defining ATAU non-defining (dengan koma)
  • "That" HANYA untuk defining (TANPA koma)
JEBAKAN #2: "Who" vs "Which" untuk Organisasi

Organisasi/perusahaan/institusi → bisa pakai "which" ATAU "who/that" (kalau dianggap sebagai sekumpulan orang)!

"The company which..." ✅ (company sebagai entitas)"The company that..." ✅ (versatile)"The team who..." ✅ (team sebagai orang-orang)"The team which..." ✅ (team sebagai entitas)

Konteks menentukan! Tapi umumnya:

  • Organisasi singular → "which" atau "that"
  • Organisasi sebagai kumpulan orang → "who" atau "that"
JEBAKAN #3: Salah Mengidentifikasi Rujukan Klausa "Which"

Contoh 1:

"Scientists analyzed the data, which revealed unexpected patterns."

"Which" merujuk ke:

A. Scientists ❌ ("which" bukan untuk orang!)B. Data ✅ BENAR!

Tapi perhatikan Contoh 2:

"Scientists analyzed the data incorrectly, which led to wrong conclusions."

"Which" merujuk ke:

A. Data ❌ (data nggak "lead to conclusions")B. Fakta bahwa analisis salah ✅ (whole clause!)Strategi Menjawab Pertanyaan Relative PronounIkuti langkah-langkah sistematis ini:STEP 1: Identifikasi tipe relative pronoun-nyaSTEP 2: Tentukan apa yang BISA dirujuk: • Who/whom → ORANG • Which → BENDA/HEWAN/SELURUH KLAUSA • That → ORANG atau BENDA • Whose → KEPEMILIKAN (orang atau benda)STEP 3: Lihat NOUN tepat sebelum relative pronoun (biasanya itu antecedent-nya!)STEP 4: Cek logika: Apakah masuk akal?STEP 5: Kalau "which" dengan koma, pertimbangkan interpretasi whole clauseSTEP 6: Verifikasi dengan substitusiMini Practice: Analisis Bacaan Lengkap

Yuk kita praktik dengan bacaan berikut:

"Dr. Martinez, who has extensive experience in neuroscience, leads a team that investigates brain plasticity. The research, which has received international recognition, focuses on neural regeneration. One of the breakthroughs involved stem cells, while another utilized gene therapy. Such innovations offer hope for patients whose conditions were previously untreatable."

Analisis Reference:ReferenceMerujuk KePenjelasan"who"Dr. MartinezOrang sebagai subject"that"teamBenda/grup sebagai subject"which"researchAtau mungkin fakta tentang research"One"one (breakthrough)Salah satu terobosan"another"another (breakthrough)Terobosan lainnya"Such innovations"stem cell & gene therapyJenis-jenis inovasi tersebut"whose"patients'Kepemilikan (possessive)

Contoh sempurna bagaimana berbagai tipe reference bekerja sama dalam teks akademik!

Dengan memahami semua jenis reference ini, kamu akan jauh lebih mudah memahami teks bahasa Inggris yang kompleks dan menjawab soal-soal SNBT dengan percaya diri! Keep practicing! 🚀

title: Materi 3.2.5: Analisis Ambiguous Reference
content:
Materi 3.2.5: Analisis Ambiguous ReferenceAmbiguous reference itu kondisi di mana satu pronoun bisa merujuk ke lebih dari satu possible antecedent, bikin makna jadi unclear atau open to interpretation. Di SNBT, kamu harus bisa resolve ambiguity ini pakai context clues!Apa Itu Ambiguous Reference?

Ambiguous reference terjadi ketika satu kata ganti (pronoun) bisa merujuk ke lebih dari satu kemungkinan antecedent, yang bikin makna kalimat jadi nggak jelas atau bisa diinterpretasikan dengan berbagai cara.

Contoh sederhana:

"Sarah told Emma that she got the promotion."

Nah, "she" di sini siapa? Sarah atau Emma?
→ AMBIGUOUS! Bisa either one!

Kabar baiknya: Teks SNBT biasanya nggak deliberately ambiguous! Penulis akademik dilatih untuk menulis dengan jelas. Tapi kadang, complexity dari sentence structure bisa bikin reference terlihat ambiguous di pandangan pertama.

Tugas kamu: Belajar cara resolve ambiguity pakai context clues!

Skenario Umum yang Bikin AmbiguousSkenario 1: Multiple Nouns dengan Same Number/Gender

Contoh:

"The professor told the student that he needed to revise the paper."

"He" itu siapa? Professor atau student?
→ Both masculine, both singular → grammatically bisa either!

Cara Resolve:

Clue #1: Kalimat berikutnya kasih clarification
"The professor told the student that he needed to revise the paper. The student immediately started working on the corrections."
→ Aha! "He" = student!Clue #2: Logic/Context
"The professor told the student that he needed to revise the paper before the deadline."
→ Logically, student yang revise paper, bukan professor!Clue #3: Verb form/tense consistency
"The professor told the student that he had made several errors."
→ "Had made" suggests yang melakukan action → student!Skenario 2: Pronoun dengan Multiple Possible Singular Antecedents

Contoh:

"The study examined the effectiveness of the new drug. It showed promising results."

"It" refers to apa?

  • A. Study
  • B. Effectiveness
  • C. Drug

→ Grammatically, semua singular, semua bisa!

Resolution:

Logic check: Apa yang "showed results"?

  • Study showed results? ✅ Makes sense (study yang provide results)
  • Effectiveness showed results? ❌ Weird (effectiveness itu abstract, nggak "show" results)
  • Drug showed results? ⚠️ Possible, tapi usually "study/research" yang "show"

Jawaban: "It" most likely = Study (paling masuk akal dalam konteks academic writing)

Confirmation dari kalimat berikutnya: "...It showed promising results. The research team plans to conduct further trials."
→ "Research team" connects to "study" → confirms "it" = study!Skenario 3: "This" atau "That" dengan Multiple Ideas

Contoh:

"The government increased taxes, cut public spending, and reduced subsidies. This angered many citizens."

"This" refers to apa?

  • A. Government
  • B. Taxes
  • C. Spending cuts
  • D. Subsidy reduction
  • E. ALL of the above policies

Kesalahan umum: Pilih noun yang paling deket (subsidies)

Pendekatan yang benar:

Tanya: Apa yang "angered citizens"?
→ Bukan satu specific policy, tapi combination of all policies!

Jawaban: "This" = The government's economic policies atau All these measures (keseluruhan ide!)

Skenario 4: Chain of References

Contoh kompleks:

"Professor Lee asked her assistant to analyze the data. She wanted it completed by Friday so that she could include it in her presentation."

Multiple pronouns! Siapa/apa yang dimaksud masing-masing?

Breaking it down:

  1. "She" (pertama) → Professor Lee (subject of wanting)
  2. "It" (pertama) → the data analysis / the task (to be completed)
  3. "She" (kedua) → Professor Lee (could include)
  4. "It" (kedua) → the data / the analysis (to be included)
  5. "Her" → Professor Lee's (possessive)
Strategi untuk chain references:
Step 1: Map out semua pronouns dalam paragraph
Step 2: Mulai dengan yang paling obvious (possessive biasanya paling mudah)
Step 3: Pakai logic untuk link setiap pronoun
Step 4: Check consistency (apakah ceritanya masuk akal?)Proximity Principle: Near vs Far

General Rule: Pronoun biasanya refers ke nearest compatible noun.

Contoh:

"The company announced new policies regarding employee benefits. They will take effect next month."

"They" → policies (nearest plural noun)

TAPI, Proximity ≠ Always Correct!

Counter-Example:

"The CEO discussed the financial reports with the board members. He emphasized the need for cost reduction."

"He" → CEO (bukan "reports" atau "members", meskipun lebih deket!)

Why? Logic! Reports dan members nggak bisa "emphasize", tapi CEO bisa!

PELAJARAN: Proximity helps, TAPI logic trumps proximity!Number Agreement sebagai Clue

Number agreement itu powerful clue untuk eliminate ambiguity!

Contoh:

"The research team analyzed various samples. They discovered significant anomalies."

"They" → samples (plural) BUKAN team (usually singular "it")

TAPI:

"The research team worked tirelessly. They published their findings last month."

"They" → team (treated as plural, individuals)

British vs American English:
• British: Collective nouns sering plural ("the team are...")
• American: Collective nouns biasanya singular ("the team is...")

Di SNBT: Follow verb agreement yang digunakan dalam teks itu sendiri!Gender Agreement sebagai Clue

Kalau ada pronoun dengan gender (he/she), that's a strong clue!

Contoh:

"Dr. Amanda Chen and Professor Robert Smith collaborated on the project. She provided the theoretical framework while he conducted the experiments."

  • "She" → Dr. Amanda Chen (female)
  • "He" → Professor Robert Smith (male)

Easy! Gender makes it clear!

Tapi hati-hati: Modern texts kadang pakai "they" sebagai singular gender-neutral:
"Each researcher must submit their report."
"Their" (singular) → each researcher (gender-neutral)Verb Agreement sebagai Clue

Verb forms bisa bantu identify antecedent!

Contoh:

"The scientist and his team presented their findings. He explained the methodology while they answered questions."

  • "He explained" → singular subject → scientist
  • "They answered" → plural subject → team

Tense Consistency:

"The experiment failed, and the researchers were disappointed. It had been conducted under strict conditions."

"It" → experiment (singular, "had been conducted" matches "experiment")

Context and World Knowledge

Kadang, common sense dan world knowledge resolve ambiguity!

Contoh:

"The patient consulted the doctor about the symptoms. She prescribed medication."

"She" → most likely doctor (karena doctors yang prescribe, bukan patients!)

Contoh 2:

"The tree fell on the car during the storm. It was completely destroyed."

"It" → probably the car (trees nggak gampang "destroyed", tapi cars bisa!)

The "Whole Clause" Reference

Salah satu penyebab ambiguity: kadang pronoun refers ke ENTIRE clause, bukan specific noun!

Contoh:

"The government ignored expert warnings and proceeded with the plan anyway. This proved to be a costly mistake."

"This" refers to:

  • A. Government (❌)
  • B. Warnings (❌)
  • C. Plan (⚠️ Possible tapi incomplete)
  • D. The fact that government ignored warnings and proceeded (✅ WHOLE ACTION!)
Clue: "Proved to be a mistake" → apa yang bisa jadi mistake? Bukan noun, tapi action/decision!Resolution Strategies Recap

Ketika menghadapi potentially ambiguous reference:

STRATEGY 1: READ NEXT SENTENCE(S)
Sering kasih clarification lewat restatement atau continuationSTRATEGY 2: CHECK NUMBER/GENDER AGREEMENT
Eliminate pilihan yang nggak matchSTRATEGY 3: APPLY LOGIC/COMMON SENSE
Pilihan mana yang paling masuk akal dalam konteks?STRATEGY 4: CHECK VERB AGREEMENT
Tense, form, subject-verb agreement bisa kasih cluesSTRATEGY 5: CONSIDER WHOLE-IDEA INTERPRETATION
Especially untuk "this", "that", "which" dengan commaSTRATEGY 6: USE PROXIMITY AS GUIDE (not rule!)
Nearest compatible noun sering correct, tapi verify dengan logicSTRATEGY 7: TRACE BACK THROUGH SENTENCE STRUCTURE
Follow grammatical connections (subject, object, possessive)Common Patterns yang Bikin AmbiguousPatternContohResolution StrategyTwo people, one pronoun"John asked Michael if he could help."Look for who is in position to help → likely MichaelMultiple singular nouns"The report included the recommendation and conclusion. It was well-received."What could be "well-received"? → The report (entire document)Organization + People"The company told employees that they would benefit.""They" → employees (people benefit, not abstract company)Abstract + Concrete noun"The success of the project was remarkable. It exceeded expectations."What "exceeded"? → Success (success yang exceed expectations)
Practice Approach untuk Ambiguous ReferenceLangkah-langkah ketika menemui reference question:STEP 1: Baca kalimat yang mengandung pronounSTEP 2: Baca kalimat SEBELUMNYASTEP 3: Identifikasi SEMUA possible antecedents (nouns yang match number/gender)STEP 4: Eliminate berdasarkan:
• Number mismatch
• Gender mismatch (kalau applicable)
• Logical impossibilitySTEP 5: Dari pilihan yang tersisa, pilih yang:
• Paling masuk akal secara logic
• Cocok dengan konteks
• Maintain coherence dalam narrativeSTEP 6: VERIFY dengan substitution (ganti pronoun dengan pilihanmu → make sense?)STEP 7: Kalau masih uncertain, check kalimat berikutnya untuk confirmationReal Example Breakdown

Mari kita breakdown contoh yang lebih kompleks:

"Climate scientists have been warning about rising temperatures for decades. Despite their warnings, global emissions continue to increase. This has led to accelerating ice melt in polar regions. They are now calling for immediate action before it becomes irreversible."

Mari identify setiap reference:

"This" (led to accelerating ice melt) refers to:

• Warnings ❌ (logic fail)
• Emissions increasing ✅ (makes sense!)

Answer: "The fact that global emissions continue to increase" (whole idea)"They" (calling for action) refers to:

• Temperatures ❌ (nggak bisa call)
• Emissions ❌ (nggak bisa call)
• Polar regions ❌ (nggak bisa call)
• Climate scientists ✅

Answer: "Climate scientists""It" (becomes irreversible) refers to:

• Action ❌ (context nggak pas)
• Ice melt ✅ (possible!)
• The situation/damage ✅ (paling likely!)

Answer: "The climate damage/situation" (implied dari context)

See? Step by step, dengan logic dan context clues, ambiguity bisa resolved!

Final TipsDon't overthink! Teks SNBT dirancang untuk bisa dipahami. Kalau kamu bingung, biasanya context akan kasih clue yang cukup jelas.Trust logic over proximity. Nearest noun bukan always the answer.Read full context. Jangan cuma fokus on satu kalimat. Surrounding sentences provide crucial clues!When in doubt, whole-idea interpretation sering works untuk "this", "that", "which"!Practice makes perfect. Semakin banyak kamu practice, semakin cepat kamu recognize patterns!Key Takeaway: Reference questions di SNBT itu test ketelitian dan logic kamu. Selalu baca context, check number/gender agreement, apply common sense, dan VERIFY jawabanmu dengan substitution!

Keep practicing, dan kamu bakal makin jago identify references dengan cepat dan akurat! 🚀
